from pathlib import Path

h = Path("/app/handlers.go").read_text()

# FLEET-003: Fix XOR keystream reuse - add per-item nonce
old_enc = '''// Reused keystream (no per-message nonce): same mask XORs every item.
	mask := streamMask(exportStreamKey, len(plain))
	cipher := make([]byte, len(plain))
	for i := range plain {
		cipher[i] = plain[i] ^ mask[i]
	}'''

new_enc = '''// FIXED: per-request nonce prevents keystream reuse
	nonce := make([]byte, 8)
	_, _ = rand.Read(nonce)
	mask := streamMask(exportStreamKey+":"+hex.EncodeToString(nonce), len(plain))
	cipher := make([]byte, len(nonce)+len(plain))
	copy(cipher, nonce)
	for i := range plain {
		cipher[len(nonce)+i] = plain[i] ^ mask[i]
	}'''

assert old_enc in h, "old encryptedExportHandler encryption block not found"
h = h.replace(old_enc, new_enc)

# Also fix the response to include nonce + larger ciphertext
old_resp = '''	resp := map[string]any{"item": item, "cipher_hex": hex.EncodeToString(cipher)}'''
new_resp = '''	resp := map[string]any{"item": item, "nonce_hex": hex.EncodeToString(nonce), "cipher_hex": hex.EncodeToString(cipher)}'''
assert old_resp in h, "old response map not found"
h = h.replace(old_resp, new_resp)

old_login = '''func loginHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
